frozen: 2026-10-12, before any VOCR3 candidate (every study-2 run included) was scored on any development or test set (commit time in git)
goal: VOCR3: console-sized recognizers trained on the best recipe the synth3 studies support, one per size class, each compared head to head with the released models it would replace, in one locked report.

FL10.topology: FL10's exactly: width 1.0, bottleneck 96, depth 1, ctx 2, ctx_k 5, height 32
FL10.replaces: VOCR1 (the released FL10; VOCR2 is an opt-in trial that did not qualify)

H15.topology: width 1.5, bottleneck 96, depth 1, ctx 2, ctx_k 5, height 32

VOCR_H15.release: v0.2.0 (identical to vita-jp-overlay main's default, core/vocr_ocr.c)

H15.replaces: VOCR_H15 (the overlay default users run; the bar VOCR3-H15 must beat)

W20.topology: width 2.0, bottleneck 96, depth 1, ctx 2, ctx_k 5, height 32 (train2's F20 size; added by amendment 1)

F20.note: same size, reference only; its sha256 is pinned in the report spec from the release asset

W20.replaces: VOCR_H15 if it qualifies against it and fits the budget below

budget.source: docs/vita-memory-budget.md (#53, main db9ca0c): BUDGET_READY weights<=1600000 arena<=262144 ms<=550, the ceiling for a model inside vita-jp-overlay on a PCH-1000; RAM is not the limit, speed is, then the shared 2 MiB L2
budget.rule: every candidate's W8I blob is checked with vita/budget_sweep.py check (blob bytes, W8I arena, and the high bound of vita/a9_cycles.py's W8I estimate for a 640-px line on one A9 core at 333 MHz, on synth-val lines only); a candidate that fails any limit is not selectable. The ms figure is a host estimate, never a console measurement. Train2's F20 shape is at 311-548 ms, inside the ceiling with 2 ms to spare; the doc's other in-budget shapes (w150d2, w150b128, w150c4) are not candidates because the architecture sweep found depth, context blocks and a wider head add nothing over plain width once real data is in the mix (docs/arch-sweep.md)

candidates.rule: For each size, the candidates are the final fine-tune checkpoints (EMA weights, no checkpoint selection inside a run) of the runs below that use the VN-style synthetic data study 2 recommends for that size (eval/synth3_study2_protocol.json decision). If study 2 finds no measured difference for a size, the runs of both arms are candidates.

W20.script: eval/vocr3_run.sh W20 ARM 1 (study 2's recipe at width 2.0, 32,000 pretrain steps as train2's p20; outputs under $HERD/shared/artifacts/synth3/vocr3/runs)
W20.rule: all three are candidates and all three must finish before the W20 selection; there is no study-2 decision at this width. B_s3 is included because study 1's H15-width secondary favoured synth3 alone (B - A -0.52, CI -0.80 to -0.25; one seed)

variants.status: optional; each is trained only if its precondition holds, and enters the candidate list only through the ablation rule below

realplus.precondition: realplus.status POOL_READY <commit>, with its manifest committed and its measured blind-check precision reported
realplus.run: from the pretrain checkpoint of the size's base selection (below), same seed, the study-2 fine-tune with the real half re-split as tt 0.2 + rd 0.1 + rp 0.2 (tt and rd: the CLANNAD-free copies of amendment 1; the realplus pool, inv=0.5, kd=0; no ps); the synthetic half unchanged
realplus.ablation_rule: it replaces the base selection iff its teacher_val CER (both views) is lower with the VN-cluster 95% interval of the difference entirely below 0 (and, when devnative is a selection cohort, devnative's interval is not entirely above 0)

synth3_v3.precondition: synth3-v3's study 1b result (eval/synth3_study1b_protocol.json) committed with D_s3v3 better than B_s3 under its rule
synth3_v3.run: only when the size's recommended arm uses synth3: one full study-2 run of that arm with synth3 v3 in place of v2 (same seed as the base selection), FL10 first
synth3_v3.ablation_rule: as for realplus, against the base selection

variants.amendments: Further variants may be added only by an amendment committed before that variant is scored on any development set; protected sets are never used to add, drop or tune a variant.

export: eval/synth3_ablation.py export (train/export.py, per-channel int8) -> C runtime W8I; blob bytes and arena from runtime/pyvocr.py at max width 1024

cohorts.devnative: agent devnative's native Vita/PSP cohort (strict and tv_native subsets; scene_vn reported only), a selection cohort if and only if its manifest is committed (COHORT_FROZEN) before the first VOCR3 selection score of that size

selection.score: development CER = errors / reference characters (eval/metrics.norm, Levenshtein) over teacher_val in both views; with devnative as a cohort, the mean of teacher_val's CER and devnative's CER (both views, strict + tv_native lines)
selection.base_rule: per size, the candidate with the lowest development score; ties at 5 decimals go to the shorter pretrain, then the lower seed
selection.commit: the selection (every candidate's development score, the chosen run, its blob sha256) is committed before the locked report runs

locked_report.when: once, after both sizes' selections (including any variant ablation) are committed
locked_report.tool: eval/vocr3_report.py (agent vocr3-harness, verified by reproducing the released blobs' published numbers), the commit recorded in the report

arms.VOCR3-FL10-C3: the FL10 selection + TEXTBOX (C3): finder-matched to VOCR2, reported only

sets.vita-test, psp-test fixed lines: eval/run.py's recognizer mode through the scalar C W8I runtime; console polarity primary, native also; per set, per style, per VN, pooled; full text and hiragana
sets.vita-test, psp-test whole dialogue: each region at base and +4/+8 native px with the arm's own C finder (the VOCR2 held-out guard's scoring)
sets.fresh native textbox test: eval/fresh_native_textbox.py through the harness adapter, only if the owner provides its private inputs and execution authorization before the report runs; reported with the disclosure that synth3 v2's name pool held 39 names unique to its titles (docs/synth3.md, Limits)
sets.CLANNAD long run: eval/clannad_longrun.py through the harness adapter on the stored captures, only if the owner provides the private inputs; Google Lens readings are a proxy, not human references

locked_report.statistics: CAND - BASE in points with paired bootstrap 95% intervals (10,000 resamples, seed 0) over lines and over VN clusters (strata with at least 5 VNs)
also: blob bytes, W8I and W8F arenas
estimated Vita Cortex-A9 time per line from vita/a9_cycles.py (host estimate, marked as such)
the overlay host cross-check: vita-jp-overlay's tools/benchmark_local_ocr.py on a read-only clone (no change, no PR there)

qualification.fixed_line_gate: VOCR2's: in the primary polarity, no set's full-text or hiragana errors increase, and pooled hiragana errors decrease
qualification.dialogue_guard: VOCR2's held-out whole-dialogue guard: no title/variant all-text or body full/hiragana regression; every variant improves console-balanced hiragana in both scopes and gains on at least two titles
qualification.consequence: A candidate qualifies to replace its baseline only if every gate passes on every set available; even then the default changes only with the owner's agreement. Nothing is merged. Results are reported whether or not they qualify.

publication: draft PR feat/vocr3 (stacked on feat/synth3) with docs/vocr3.md, this protocol, the selection and the report JSON; weights only as a release asset with the owner's agreement
hygiene: no candidate, variant, recipe, checkpoint or threshold is chosen, tuned or dropped on vita-test, psp-test, the fresh native textbox test or CLANNAD
the locked report runs once; its numbers cannot change the selection
realplus and devnative exclude every test VN and family, CLANNAD, the fresh native test's titles and relations, and every eval screenshot (their own manifests record it)

amendments.date: 2026-10-12 (commit time in git), before any VOCR3 candidate was scored
amendments.change: (1) A third size, W20 (width 2.0, data/vocab.txt; train2's F20 size), with three candidate runs (C_mix, A_s2, B_s3, seed 1) from eval/vocr3_run.sh, the same base rule, the report arm VOCR3-W20, the released F20 as a same-size reference, the pairs VOCR3-W20 vs VOCR_H15, F20 and VOCR3-H15, and the gate VOCR3-W20 vs VOCR_H15. (2) The vita-budget ceiling (weights <= 1,600,000 B, W8I arena <= 262,144 B, estimated <= 550 ms per 640-px line) as a selectability rule for every size. (3) Every VOCR3 fine-tune, including study 2's (its amendment 2) and the realplus variant, uses the copies of teacher_train, real_train and the pseudo-label pools without CLANNAD (v4) and its VNDB family (eval/synth3_study2_pools.sha256).
amendments.reason: The owner allowed a slightly larger model if it fits a PCH-1000 inside vita-jp-overlay, and the vita-budget agent set the ceiling at 20:5xZ; the first synth3 audit (B1) found CLANNAD crops in the inherited pools.
amendments.unchanged: the FL10 and H15 sizes, their candidates and baselines, the selection cohorts and rule, the locked report's sets and statistics, the qualification gates for FL10 and H15, publication and hygiene
